title: 514. Arithmetic Slices II - Subsequence

examples.explanation: Five triples with gap 2 plus [2,6,10] plus the length-5 progression.
All 10 triples plus 5 quadruples plus 1 quintuple.

hints: For each pair (j,i) record the gap; every earlier pair ending at j with the same gap extends to i.
Keep per-index maps from gap to count of weak pairs (length >= 2) ending there.
Only extensions that reach length 3 or more add to the answer.
